baseline_source: reports/tickets/Sprint26-18/VCST-5910/testing-checklist.md § A11y findings — vcst-qa, 2026-09-08, theme 2.57.0-pr-2471-6ed5, Red preset

runs.cause: POST /graphql 400 — Argument 'storeId' of type 'String!' is required for field 'loyaltyBalance' but not provided. /account/missions rendered no cards; every surface PR #2479 changes was unreachable.
runs.environment_scope: NOT local-only at the time — the identical dev-branch document returned the identical 400 on vcst-qa, verified by live introspection and a live POST
runs.unblocked_by: operator updated the loyalty module on localhost; loyaltyBalance no longer requires storeId (live introspection confirmed). This moved localhost away from vcst-qa, which still declares storeId: String! against a storefront that does not send it — that break is unchanged and still live there.
runs.evidence_loss: run 1's two VCST-5911-BLOCKER-*.png are gone from disk and were never git-tracked, so unrecoverable. Cause unknown. Run 1's finding is fully evidenced in text; loss recorded rather than absorbed.

runs.missions_read: totalCount 16 — 12 on page 1 + 4 on page 2, all read on all 3 passes

defects_verified_fixed.method: live getComputedStyle on every card, both themes, 3 passes; orchestrator independently recomputed the ratios from the reported hexes
defects_verified_fixed.result: warning 2.09:1 -> 4.53:1 (#ab660e, --color-warning-700). success 7.18:1. Dark 4.37:1 / 12.54:1. Min observed 4.53:1, 16/16 light and 12/12 dark.

defects_verified_fixed.defect: WCAG 1.4.1 — status conveyed by colour alone on daysRemaining: null
defects_verified_fixed.method: NOT exercised live (no InProgress + daysRemaining:null fixture on this env). Verified instead from source at PR head cf20b0ad: useMissionCard.ts now declares `let dateLabel: string` with no "" default and an exhaustive if/else-if/else, so TypeScript enforces assignment on every path — no code path can render a dot with no label. Corroborated live: 0 of 16 cards has an empty .mission-date-badge in either theme on all 3 passes.
defects_verified_fixed.result: closed by construction; stronger than a single live observation

not_exercised: The literal "No deadline" string — needs an InProgress mission with daysRemaining: null; the only null-days mission on this env is status Completed, which correctly shows "Mission completed" instead.

The danger band (<10 days) — AGENT-TEST-MSN-ENDING-SOON has daysRemaining 5 but is Completed, so it resolves to success. Danger dot #a01313 vs warning-500 bar #fc9e00 = 3.86:1 is computed from live tokens, not observed.

bugs_not_filed.reason_not_filed: Already tracked — vc-frontend PR #2475 (VCST-5024) is the in-flight fix; VCST-5024's test model carries it as scenario 15. Still unresolved on vcst-qa.

bugs_not_filed.finding: Full-width danger alert 'Our server is currently experiencing technical issues' on every missions load, caused by the ws://localhost/graphql subscription-transport failure while the page itself works.
bugs_not_filed.reason_not_filed: Local-env infra, not PR-attributable and not reproducible off this machine. UX observation only.

notes: The dark-theme override in dark/atoms/vc-badge.scss is INERT on the Red preset — that preset defines --color-vc-background-solid-*, which wins by the PR's own var() precedence. Dark-mode green is not proof that rule works.
axe-core has no automated rule for WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast; it corroborates only that no AA text contrast regressed. The dot evidence is the getComputedStyle measurement.
Two fixtures would close the unexercised paths: an InProgress mission with daysRemaining: null, and one with daysRemaining < 10.
caveat: Run against localhost on an open/unmerged PR branch build at the operator's direction. VERIFIED means the fix works; it does NOT mean the fix is on vcst-qa. Merge, deploy and spot-check there still required.
